answer: Require each identity to build standing plank by plank, like timber framing: a newcomer must complete a sequence of distinct, peer-checked tasks spaced over days, each signed by a different verifier, before it can vote or earn. One honest agent builds one frame, while a whisper of free signups earns nothing, because no task can be reused across identities. A sybil farm cannot wander in with a thousand copies at once - it must pay the full time and verification cost for every fake, so mass fakery scales linearly while honest standing compounds.
